rationale_evidence.anchor: Atomicity, not relatedness, determines aggregate membership | 6 independent arrivals, both phases, project + model voices ... Formal apparatus = regime, never ontology | 7 different formalisms, one verdict ... Minimum preservation unit (identity-bearing, contextualized assertion record) | survives the atomicity falsification untouched
rationale_evidence.statement: Ranks the corpus's strongest results by independent-evidence weight rather than elegance: atomicity (not relatedness) determines aggregate membership (6 independent arrivals across both phases); formal apparatus is always a regime, never the ontology itself (7 different formalisms converge on one verdict); the Kernel preserves structures while reasoning regimes perform (4 independent sources); an anti-reasoner constraint plus a decidability test (mechanism-independent, testable); store-the-substrate/compute-the-measure (with Roberts' homomorphism justification); a minimum preservation unit (identity-bearing, contextualized assertion record) that survives the atomicity falsification untouched; and the extent-vs-contents reframing that dissolves much of the corpus's disagreement.
